name: Coma DF08 (Hubble)
blurb: DF08, an ultra-diffuse galaxy in the Coma Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: df08-hubble
story: A galaxy nearly as wide as a bright one but with only a thin haze of stars, drifting in the Coma Cluster. Hubble came to count its globular clusters, clues to how such faint giants formed.

claims.text: DF08 is an ultra-diffuse galaxy in the Coma cluster observed by Hubble program 15121
DF names come from the Dragonfly Coma cluster survey
Coma's ultra-diffuse galaxies are as large as bright galaxies but with few stars
Program 15121 targets extreme ultra-diffuse galaxies in the Coma region to test whether globular cluster formation precedes galaxy formation
